purpose: Pre-registered acceptance rule for calling this project's harm numbers confirmatory. Set before any human label on this distribution existed, so it cannot be moved to fit the result.
not_permitted_after_seeing_labels: changing judge models or the majority rule
re-labelling by the same auditor after seeing panel verdicts
on_failure: Claims stay exploratory: headline_eligible remains false, the workbench keeps answering insufficient evidence, and the measured sensitivity/specificity are published as the limitation.
on_success: The panel counts as calibrated on this distribution only; claims become eligible for review, and every other caveat (one model, one seed, judge error, exploratory split) still applies.
